summary: The Theme is the one owner of the palette and the type scale, and the battle, the shell, the atmosphere and the audio sheet adopt it: BattlePalette and ShellStyle become thin readers, every UI hex literal is deleted, a game colour survives only where it is marked as one, and a suite refuses the rest.

coordination.notes: game/scripts/world/ and game/scripts/board/ are lane P10's this round and are not touched here; their constants are named in the completion checks so P10 can finish the adoption. game/themes/bronze_vellum.tres is card P5's owner and takes additive entries only -- two palette tokens the shell needs and the Theme lacked (night, hairline), two type-scale steps (wordmark, subtitle), and a MenuRow Button variation -- with no rename and no value change to anything P5 authored.
